data.name: Validation_FilePath
data.value: '{0}' is not a file under {1}/ or {2}/.
data.comment: Shown when a saved file path is not a site-relative /docs or media path.

data.name: Validation_Required
data.comment: Shown when a required dashboard field was left blank.

data.name: Validation_SlugFormat
data.value: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
data.comment: Shown when a slug fails the site's slug format rule.

data.name: Validation_SlugReserved
data.value: '{0}' is reserved by the site's own routes.
data.comment: Shown when a page slug collides with a reserved route segment.

data.name: Validation_SlugTaken
data.comment: Shown when a slug is already used by another page or post.

data.name: Validation_NotFound
data.comment: Shown when a save targets an id that no longer exists.

data.name: Validation_LabelBothLanguages
data.value: Every link needs an English and an Arabic label.
data.comment: Shown when a navigation link is missing one of its two labels.

data.name: Validation_Href
data.value: '{0}' is not a link the site can render.
data.comment: Shown when a navigation link's href is not a site path, fragment, mailto/tel, or absolute http(s) URL.

data.name: Validation_BodyEmpty
data.comment: Shown when a news post's body sanitises down to nothing.

data.name: Validation_SettingKey
data.value: '{0}' is not a setting the site reads.
data.comment: Shown when a settings save includes a key the layout does not read.

data.name: Validation_Email
data.comment: Shown when a contact email setting is not a plausible address.

data.name: Validation_City
data.comment: Shown when an event save does not reference a city that exists.

data.name: Validation_DateEnd
data.value: The end date is before the start date.
data.comment: Shown when an event's end date is earlier than its start date.

data.name: Validation_Capacity
data.value: Capacity must be a positive number or empty.
data.comment: Shown when an event's capacity is zero or negative.

data.name: Validation_ExternalUrl
data.value: External registration needs an https link.
data.comment: Shown when an event's external registration mode is missing a safe https URL.

data.name: Validation_GalleryFile
data.value: A gallery image needs a file.
data.comment: Shown when a gallery image row has no file path.

data.name: Validation_CityHasEvents
data.value: This city still has events; move them first.
data.comment: Shown when a city delete is refused because an event still references it.

data.name: Validation_DuplicateRow
data.value: The same row was submitted twice.
data.comment: Shown when a posted list of child rows (gallery, results, blocks, navigation) carries the same id twice.

data.name: Validation_GuideNeedsContent
data.value: Add a PDF or at least one chapter before publishing.
data.comment: Shown when a training guide is published with neither a file nor a chapter.

data.name: Validation_FileSize
data.value: The file size cannot be negative.
data.comment: Shown when a saved file's size is a negative number.

data.name: Validation_File
data.comment: Shown when the media store rejects an upload's bytes (wrong type, mismatched kind, or over the size limit).

data.name: Validation_HomeOrder
data.value: Home-page tiles need distinct positions 1 to 4.
data.comment: Shown when a KPI's home-band position is out of range or clashes with another home KPI.

data.name: Validation_YearDuplicate
data.value: Each year may appear only once.
data.comment: Shown when a posted growth-series list carries the same year twice.

data.name: Validation_KeyDuplicate
data.value: Each key may appear only once.
data.comment: Shown when a posted region list carries the same key twice.

data.name: Validation_Range
data.value: A value is out of range.
data.comment: Shown when a posted region/growth row's athlete count is negative, or a growth row's year is outside 2000-2100.
